Legal Lens is an AI utility and does not

findings.message: 5 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "AI-Powered Legal Clarity" (pill) above "Justice begins with understanding."; "Secure Legal Console" above "Decode your documents instantly"; "Three-Step Process" above "Democratizing Legalese"; "Core Capabilities" above "Legal insights, simplified"; "Frequently Asked Questions" above "Got questions? We have answers."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: Share Tech Mono — e.g. "AI-Powered Legal Clarity", "Supported Standards:", "Secure Legal Console", "Or try a sample agreement:"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 9 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "AI-Powered Legal Clarity", "Supported Standards:", "Secure Legal Console", "Three-Step Process").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 2 gradient fill(s): div.hero-glow-1 → radial-gradient(circle, rgba(232, 184, 75, 0.08) 0%, rgba(20, 21, 26, 0) 70%) | div.hero-glow-2 → radial-gradient(circle, rgba(61, 90, 254, 0.04) 0%, rgba(20, 21, 26, 0) 70%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: button.btn-primary.hero-cta-primary → rgba(232, 184, 75, 0.15) 0px 4px 14px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 8 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): nav.navbar 1440px | section#upload-tool.upload-section-container 1440px | div.quick-samples 361px | section#how-it-works.how-it-works-section 1440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 8 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Supports PDF, DOCX, or Image (Max 15MB)" 2.9:1 needs 4.5:1; "© 2026 Legal Lens. All rights reserved." 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Legal Lens is an AI utility and does not" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 15.2px.
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 9 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 64px (4.4vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Barlow Condensed and Barlow, but the page renders Inter, Share Tech Mono.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: 3 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Justice begins with understanding." → 3 lines (4 words, 44px); "Decode your documents instantly" → 3 lines (4 words, 40px); "Got questions? We have answers." → 3 lines (5 words, 40px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
